about: Newest first. Every deploy of a visible change adds one entry with a picture; see FEEDBACK.md.

entries.title: Ranch cards you can hold
entries.line: Open a pack of 15 Ranch cards made from the game's animals and buildings. Tilt them in the light, browse the binder, and print the whole set at studio quality. Settings, Studies, Cards.

entries.title: The voice runs the whole app
entries.line: The Computer now knows the ranch, its animals and the other worlds. Ask for a real barn, more goats, winter, a new tile or the moon base, and it does it.

entries.title: A sound library
entries.line: 450 sounds for the ranch and beyond, picked and levelled by the sound engineer. Open Sounds from Settings to browse them; they start playing once storage is switched on.

entries.title: Talk to the world
entries.line: Tap the microphone and just say what you want: the Computer builds it as you talk. It only plays the game, and it keeps things PG.

entries.title: The workshop
entries.line: Concept art and models fly in as they're made. Tap the factory button to see every job, its progress and the machines.

entries.title: Updates and feedback from your phone
entries.line: This card shows up when a new version is ready. Tap the speech bubble to send Claude a picture and a note.
